observations: Six identical-looking laptops are shown in three photos, arranged in two rows of three.
All laptops are open, displaying different Windows desktop wallpapers.
The laptops are dark gray or black with a Dell logo visible on the lower bezel of the screen in photo 2 (bottom left laptop).
Each laptop has a full-sized keyboard, a large trackpad, and a small blue Intel sticker on the bottom right of the keyboard deck.
The screens appear to be 13-inch, based on size relative to the keyboard and bezel.
No visible damage or wear is apparent from the photos, but the surface they are placed on is dusty or dirty, suggesting they may not be in pristine condition.
